printed: Avenue (Vista, name not printed at this spot)

same_names_elsewhere.note: Clayland Street (narrow; read as CLAYLAN[D] ST.) ends in a T at Potomac Avenue here

note: On the plate Clayland Street runs NW-SE only from the avenue north of block 47/48 down to Potomac Avenue and stops there. South of Potomac, block 49 (Subdiv'n lots 20-21, 59-60) runs unbroken to the avenue along the plate's SE edge (labelled AVE. near 9037,4792; this is Vista Avenue). No street continues to it in 1922.

Pogue Avenue (only AVE. printed here, 18-in sewer) runs ESE through the expected point. Nothing meets it near 4996,6436. To the north is a large estate (big spaced lettering) with no lane reaching the avenue. To the south, lots 27/17 sit on it, and the Bedford Terr. cul-de-sac (circle near 4760,6630) comes up from the south but stops short of the avenue. No Beech Lane is on the plate.

printed: Road (Duck Creek; only ROAD printed further east)
note: Duck Creek Road (36-in/42-in sewer, unnamed in this stretch) runs ESE near y 3420 at x 7590. The expected point falls inside block 35 (lots 61/62). The only other way nearby is an unnamed 30-ft private drive that curves from the west (y ~3790) south to Duck Creek. It does not meet the road. No Crane Avenue is on the plate.

same_names_elsewhere.note: Anwood Lane (printed ANWOOD LANE, short cul-de-sac with a circle near 2520,4790, The Annwood Sub.) leaves Dexter Avenue here in a T, about 600 px SE

note: Anwood St. (name printed further SW near 700,5050; only ST. near the junction) ends in a T at Dexter Avenue. On the plate Anwood Lane is a separate cul-de-sac further SE on Dexter, not at this junction.

A NW-SE avenue (house numbers 2026-2058, only AVE. printed) dead-ends at about 4425,4745, at the boundary of G.B. Foote's estate. South of that is open estate land with no streets, so there is no Hewitt Crescent. A COURT runs parallel to the west and also ends at the estate line.

East of the railroad, only the edge of a street junction is on the plate. It is a street running along the east side of the tracks, mostly off-plate. A stub goes NE (8-in sewer, 4-in W.P.) and another opening goes ESE, with block corners at about 9860,3130 and 9850,3245. No names are printed. The pick is the middle of the open junction, which is cut by the plate edge.

same_names_elsewhere.note: another stub off Vista Avenue, label reads PL./PA? (probably Vista Place)

note: A short stub (6-in sewer, label begins VIST...) leaves the S side of Vista Avenue and is cut off by the plate edge. Holly Avenue meets Vista about 190 px west, near 7575,5725.
A short stub labelled ...R PL. (with a W. PIPE) leaves the SW side of Madison Road (streetcar track) and is cut by the plate edge. The pick is on the Madison centreline at the stub's axis.

The narrow Clayland St. (read CLAYLAN[D] ST.; possibly Clayton) comes from the NW and ends at Potomac Avenue in a T. Its edges are hard to tell from the lot lines, so it is not certain exactly how wide it is.

same_names_elsewhere.note: another stub off Vista Avenue labelled VIST... (probably Vista Terrace)

note: A short stub (12-in sewer, 6-in W.P.; label partly reads PL or PA) leaves the S side of Vista Avenue and is cut off at the plate edge.

O'Bryon St. (O'BRYON printed SW near 3200,6640, ST. near the junction) runs SW-NE and ends at the Pogue (Avenue) eastern stretch, by a hydrant. POGUE is printed further west near 3250,5900. An AVE. leaves Pogue going S about 130 px east.

The road along the top edge of the plate (streetcar track, house numbers 3500-3542, name not printed) has a stub heading north off the plate (x 4778-4888). The pick is the stub's axis on the road centreline. The north half of the junction is beyond the plate edge.

Two stubs leave the SW side of Madison Road at its bend: one going W, labelled ...GE RD., and one going S, with a vertical label that looks like GRANDIN RD. Both are cut by the plate edge. O'Bryon Street meets Madison from the NE at the same bend. The pick is the middle of the open junction: the S stub's axis is at x about 3033, Madison's centreline at about y 6885, and the two stub axes meet at about y 6990.
